Smart Cleaner analyzes storage safely on your device: %1$s

Smart Cleaner %1$s
Smart Cleaner is a storage-management and maintenance app. It scans shared storage on-device for junk, exact duplicates, large files, old downloads, APK installers, media review items and WhatsApp media. Deep App Cache uses Android’s official system cache-cleaning flow; Android may require a system confirmation.
Package: com.mrzekai.depoakilli
Smart Cleaner needs Android All files access to scan shared storage comprehensively without making you pick folders one by one.

Smart Cleaner analyzes accessible shared-storage file metadata and, when needed for duplicate detection, on-device content fingerprints. These cleaner-engine fingerprints and personal files are not uploaded by Smart Cleaner.
All files access is requested because file management and maintenance are core features: scanning and managing junk, duplicates, large files, downloads, APK installers and WhatsApp media across shared storage. Android continues to block other apps’ protected private data directories.
Usage Access is optional and is used to read app storage/cache statistics and last-used timestamps. Deep App Cache invokes Android’s official cache-cleaning system action and Android controls the required confirmation.
Google Mobile Ads and the consent platform may process advertising identifiers, diagnostics and consent choices under Google policies. Files are removed only after user selection or an Android system confirmation.

Smart Cleaner provides on-device storage analysis and file-management tools. Scan results are recommendations, not backups. Review selected user files before deleting them.
Smart Cleaner can manage accessible shared-storage files after Android grants All files access. Android still protects other apps’ private internal data. Deep App Cache uses Android’s official system action and may display a required Android confirmation.
Smart Cleaner does not claim to kill protected third-party apps, boost device-wide RAM, cool the CPU, or create fictional performance gains. Availability can vary by Android version and device manufacturer.

Smart Cleaner uses Android’s All files access only for its core file-management features: scanning shared storage for junk candidates, exact duplicates, large files, downloads, APK installers and shared messaging media. Files stay on your device. You review what will be deleted. Android still protects other apps’ private data.

Usage Access is optional. It lets Smart Cleaner read Android-reported app storage/cache totals and last-used times so you can review large or unused apps. It does not read the private content inside those apps and does not silently delete their protected data.
